(Currently Amended) A method for preventing or treating glaucoma wherein (S)-(-)- 1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered for the purpose of reducing intraocular pressure in a subject in need thereof.

(Currently Amended) A method for preventing or treating ocular hypertension wherein (S)-(-)-1-(4-fluoro-5-isoquinolinesulfonyl)-2-methyl homopiperazine or a salt thereof and phosphoric acid or a salt thereof are administered for the purpose of reducing intraocular pressure in a subject in need thereof.
